svg.aria-label: A wide diagram in three lanes that follows the lab route app/sec0/a/[id]/page.tsx from file to click in fifteen numbered boxes. Build lane: 01 the source files; 02 the discovery key /sec0/a/[id]/page; 03 the routes-manifest row whose named regex is ^/sec0/a/(?<nxtPid>[^/]+?)(?:/)?$, third of 119 dynamic routes; 04 the LoaderTree literal, a nest of 4-tuples each ending in an empty array; 05 the prefetch hints 64, 96, 96, 96, 160; 06 the six files written per URL, 1.html 9,954 bytes, 1.rsc 5,866, 1.meta 1,036, _tree 275, _full 5,866 and the page segment 4,942; 07 the prerender-manifest rows, five complete static rows and a pattern row with fallback null that computes blocking. Server lane: 08 the boot tables built once by setupFsCheck; 09 the hard GET that misses check_fs, matches third, is served from the route-cache copy that the first hit promoted from the build seed, and returns x-nextjs-cache HIT with x-nextjs-prerender twice; 10 the document with two self.__next_f pushes carrying the 5,866-byte payload again. Browser lane: 11 the viewport prefetch, a _tree request with _rsc nVRY9RLVAUtqyrUj then the page segment, 24 requests for 12 links; 12 a predicted router.prefetch that sends only the 4,942-byte page segment; 13 a warm soft navigation with 0 requests in 50 ms; 14 an unprefetched navigation that receives the whole 5,866-byte payload, 1,619 bytes on the wire; 15 a navigation to /dyn whose root comes back as a skipped node, 2,602 bytes against 4,433 without the state tree. Arrows are labelled with the functions that produce each next box or read a build file at runtime.

Within a lane, boxes run in the order the code runs them. Sizes are bytes, decoded unless marked wire. Only box 13 is timed.
